Be honest… would you eat this Omurice? 

AI made the eggs look pretty… but forgot to actually mix them properly. 

This was supposed to be a simple egg-whisking scene.

Instead, AI decided to leave the yolk halfway intact. 

This is probably one of the funniest parts of making AI videos.

Sometimes everything looks beautiful… except for that one tiny detail that makes absolutely no sense.

#DiaryOfMeiyoung #AIVideo #AIFail #AIAnimation #Omurice #BehindTheScenes

How I would fix it:
Break the yolks → whisk continuously → combine the yolk and egg whites → finish with a completely smooth mixture. 

Sometimes you have to be very specific about the movement, not just the final result.

Some days don't need to be productive.

Sometimes it's enough to slow down, make something small, and let the day be what it is. 

#DiaryOfMeiyoung #LittleThoughts #DailyDiary

rows.idea: How I use a reference video
rows.caption:
One thing that changed the way I make AI cooking videos. 

I don't always ask AI to imagine the cooking movement from text.

Sometimes I use a real cooking video as a motion reference.

I keep the movement and technique — but change the character, environment and visual style.

It gives me much more control over the action.

#DiaryOfMeiyoung #AIVideo #AITutorial #MotionReference #AIAnimation #FoodAnimation
